old_core.gaussian: 14-input gateway; elnet1/elnet2 count nlp but accept no maxit argument and contain no maxit check
old_core.logistic: 15-input gateway; lognet2n/lognetn reset nit for each lambda and compare IRLS outer-iteration nit with maxit; nlp counts inner coordinate passes separately

new_core.all_reviewed_families: nlp initialized once for the path, incremented by full/active coordinate sweeps, checked against maxit
new_core.exhaustion: native negative jerr and completed prefix; detection can increment nlp to maxit+1

translation: No fixed conversion from old per-lambda outer iterations to new whole-path coordinate passes is justified by source.

bridge_defaults.gaussian_reason: Explicit bridge default matching official 2013 Matlab default; not a legacy-2008 cap and not options.maxit=100
bridge_defaults.logistic_without_explicit_control: Legacy maxit numeric value passed unchanged, with the new unit explicitly reported; no silent increase

explicit_octave_options.octave_max_passes: Positive int32 whole-path coordinate-descent pass budget; works for Gaussian/binomial/multinomial
explicit_octave_options.octave_require_complete: Require native jerr=0 and completed_lambda_count=requested_lambda_count; otherwise PMTK:GlmnetIncompletePath. This also rejects intentional native automatic-path early stopping.
explicit_octave_options.metadata: fit.octave_budget: actual limit/unit/source, passes_used, requested/completed lambda counts, native jerr

matlab: Original compiled-platform routes and original eight-output calls remain in the non-Octave branch; new fields only enabled under OCTAVE_VERSION.
